answer.evidence: The top flange shows its circular surface foreshortened into an ellipse from row 0 to row 5 (6 pixel rows) complete with a center arbor hole, followed by the flange edge (rows 6-8), the wound cable body (rows 9-12), and the bottom flange visible underneath (rows 13-14).

The top flange of the cable spool is drawn as a foreshortened ellipse viewed from above across rows 0-5 (approx 6 rows tall) complete with central arbor hole, followed by the flange edge, the wound cable drum below it (rows 9-12), and the bottom flange peeking out at rows 13-14.

The top circular flange of the reel is clearly shown foreshortened from row 0 to row 8 (9 source pixel rows tall) complete with center arbor hole, while the front south face of the drum body extends below from row 9 to row 12.
